notes: The %pvalue2 macro: per-replicate pooled two-sample t-test p-value for each continuous covariate (Z4, Z5), driven by a %scan/%countw loop, using BY-replicate PROC TTEST with ODS OUTPUT of the TTESTS table, then stacked via ttest_: wildcard. Macro body and PROC options are the author's, unchanged. Only adaptation: a small inline simulate dataset (3 replicates x 40 obs) generated with the same call streaminit + rand draws as the upstream simulation step, so the macro runs self-contained; obs=100 cap in autoexec keeps the captured run small.
